EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretching and bending features (2928, 2980, 2829 cm⁻¹; 1458, 1353, 1314 cm⁻¹), consistent with an alkyl ether ring (GFQ-003). The absence of any O–H/N–H stretching near 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ disfavors the many hydroxyl-bearing candidates (cf. GFQ-002). The broad band at 1092 cm⁻¹ matches typical C–O–C stretching in cyclic ethers, and the cluster of ring modes at 775, 834, and 851 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of 1,3‑dioxane-type rings. Candidate 5 (a dimethyl 1,3‑dioxane) best fits these features.
